title: Design of a China Cup
description: This design study explores the balance between form, proportion, and craftsmanship in a traditional China cup. The model highlights the smooth curvature, refined rim, and elegant silhouette that make the object both functional and sculptural.

title: Exhaust Manifold Thermal-Stress & Structural Failure Analysis
description: Thermal-stress and structural-failure analysis of an exhaust manifold using Ansys Mechanical. The study evaluates how temperature-driven expansion and applied loading influence the component's stress distribution and structural margin.

assets.simulationAlt: Animated Ansys results showing thermal stress across the exhaust manifold
